01

The homepage still promotes a past event

The homepage says September 18 Invisalign Day is coming and invites visitors to book, although the date has passed.

  • Remove the expired event section or replace it with a client-approved future date and offer; keep the regular Invisalign service path.
02

The homepage video is a 52 MB file

The autoplay background uses a 52 MB MP4, and its first frame appeared at 6.6 seconds in the local mobile capture.

  • Use a lightweight poster and a smaller quality-preserving background video or mobile fallback.
  • Retest the first frame and PageSpeed separately; the video is not the verified PSI LCP element.
03

Blog images are larger than their cards need

Blog/article sources include 1.19 MB and 0.97 MB PNG images, creating avoidable image weight beyond the first screen.

  • Use properly sized WebP/AVIF card images while preserving quality and originals; lazy-load only below-fold images.

Fix order

Remove the expired promotion, then reduce unnecessary media weight without sacrificing image quality.

  • Website/content: event section and quality-preserving video/image changes.
  • SEO: retain correct business data; review optional schema/metadata and legacy booking routing before new work.

Video filesize is not every visitor's download; lab and local LCP elements differ. Booking history and wider optional work are retained in the full report. No live changes made.
